pub type Raw
pub enum Evidence
  Verified
  Claimed
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum ResourceCallOutcome
  Ok
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Unknown
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>

  Acquired
  Insufficient
  HoldersRefused
  NotPermitted
  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>

  Acquired
  Insufficient

  Unavailable
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Held
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum YieldAnswer
  Yielded
  Refused
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>

pub struct Holder
  program: ::std::string::String
  account: ::std::string::String
  amount: i64
  evidence: Evidence
  lease: ::std::string::String
  grant: ::std::string::String
  since: ::std::string::String
  detail: ::std::string::String
pub struct ResourceState
  resource: ::std::string::String
  capacity: i64
  held: i64
  holders: ::std::vec::Vec<Holder>
  observed: ::std::string::String
  instrument: ::std::string::String
pub struct HoldersResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  state: ::std::option::Option<ResourceState>
pub struct ResourceList
  resources: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  observed: ::std::string::String
pub struct ResourcesResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  list: ::std::option::Option<ResourceList>
pub struct Lease
  id: ::std::string::String
  resource: ::std::string::String
  amount: i64
  since: ::std::string::String
  renew_by: ::std::string::String
pub struct YieldRecord
  holder: ::std::string::String
  amount: i64
  answer: ::std::string::String
  took_ms: i64
pub struct AcquireResult
  outcome: AcquireOutcome
  lease: ::std::option::Option<Lease>
  asked: ::std::vec::Vec<YieldRecord>
pub struct AcquireFreeResult
  outcome: AcquireFreeOutcome
  lease: ::std::option::Option<Lease>
  asked: ::std::vec::Vec<YieldRecord>
pub struct YieldRequest
  id: ::std::string::String
  resource: ::std::string::String
  amount: i64
  reason: ::std::string::String
  at: ::std::string::String
  lease: ::std::string::String
pub struct YieldPage
  requests: ::std::vec::Vec<YieldRequest>
  next: ::std::string::String
pub struct ObserveResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  page: ::std::option::Option<YieldPage>
pub struct AnswerResult
  recorded: bool
pub struct AnswerCallResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  answer: ::std::option::Option<AnswerResult>
pub struct LeaseChange
  applied: bool
  lease: ::std::option::Option<Lease>
pub struct LeaseChangeResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome
  change: ::std::option::Option<LeaseChange>
pub struct ProcessBindResult
  outcome: ProcessBindOutcome
pub fn encode(v: &ResourceState) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<ResourceState, Refusal>

pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: ::std::string::String
  message: ::std::string::String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Table
  type Error
  fn resources(&self) -> ::std::result::Result<ResourcesResult, Self::Error>
  fn holders(&self, resource: ::std::string::String, fresh: bool) -> ::std::result::Result<HoldersResult, Self::Error>
pub struct TableClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Leases
  type Error
  fn acquire_for(&self, subject: OAImported0, resource: ::std::string::String, amount: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<AcquireResult, Self::Error>
  fn acquire(&self, resource: ::std::string::String, amount: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<AcquireResult, Self::Error>
  fn acquire_free(&self, resource: ::std::string::String, amount: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<AcquireFreeResult, Self::Error>
  fn renew(&self, lease: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<LeaseChangeResult, Self::Error>
  fn release(&self, lease: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<LeaseChangeResult, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, cursor: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<ObserveResult, Self::Error>
  fn answer(&self, request: ::std::string::String, answer: YieldAnswer, reason: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<AnswerCallResult, Self::Error>
  fn bind_process(&self, lease: ::std::string::String, pid: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<ProcessBindResult, Self::Error>
  fn label(&self, lease: ::std::string::String, text: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<LeaseChangeResult, Self::Error>
pub struct LeasesClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
